text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Yes, back when I was still small... In 
this very field, I—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(I learned that there is a "pinnacle." An 
invisible summit— far, far in the 
distance.)

text_block_list.name: Young Top Road
text_block_list.text: The Twinkle Series, is it?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, it's a place where Umamusume who 
bet everything on running gather."

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Your running is certainly rough around the 
edges. But you have the stamina to sustain 
a long kick when it counts.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
And above all, your earnest personality. 
Someone like you will definitely make it 
out there in the future.

text_block_list.name: Young Top Road
text_block_list.text:
In the future, for sure... It's a little 
scary, but still...

text_block_list.name: Young Top Road
text_block_list.text: Coach... Will you take me there, Coach?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Me? Nah, I can't do it. I already turned 
in my trainer's license."

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Still, there's no need to worry. Among the 
prospective trainers of the future, there 
are folks like you out there.

text_block_list.name: Young Top Road
text_block_list.text: Like... mine?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she may not be the most skillful, 
but she's always giving it her all, 
desperately reaching higher and higher.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
If it's someone like him, maybe... I could 
trust him with you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (And time passed—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you, 
Trainer!
choice_data_list: Yeah. Likewise, I'm counting on you!
Yeah. Likewise, I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With our challenge in the Twinkle Series 
finally underway, I shared a refreshing 
handshake with Narita Top Road.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, what a surprise. To think that 
Narita Top Road and I were pupils of the 
very same teacher.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I knew she had enrolled in Tracen Academy, 
but... I never imagined you'd be the one 
training her.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Way back when I was coaching at the 
Umamusume Kids' Club, Top Road joined us. 
She stood out even back then."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I missed my chance to jump in...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Still... to think Trainer and Coach knew 
each other. What an amazing 
coincidence...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'm the Trainer and Narita Top 
Road is the Umamusume. Our positions are 
completely opposite, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: We're the same... aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"We're the same, aren't we! Our goal is to 
live up to everyone's expectations. And 
then, one day—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The two of us will definitely reach the 
summit of the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Standing at the top is her dream. And—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's also a way to repay the teacher who 
took care of us. One day, the two of us 
will definitely bring good news.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Without further ado, let's start training, 
please!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaahhh--!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa-whoa-whoa! Huh? Again...?
choice_data_list: Watch out for taking the turn too wide.

Watch out for taking the turn too wide, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Accelerating through the corners is 
difficult, isn't it? If you're too early, 
you get pushed out, and if you're too 
late, you can't stretch out your lead...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sheer scale of Narita Top Road's 
running is remarkable. Her stride is 
massive, and her top speed is blazing. 
But...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I have to hammer it into my body for a 
while. Again and again...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's a bit clumsy, and it takes her time 
to adapt to different situations. Even so, 
however...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, sorry to trouble you, but could 
you please keep me company thoroughly 
today?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to get used to it as much as 
possible before my Make Debut!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her seriousness and single-minded 
dedication far outweigh that clumsiness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it's just little by little, as 
long as she keeps growing—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I want to catch up as soon as 
possible. To... "that Umamusume".

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
To at least keep her back in sight. That's 
my immediate goal!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even before making her debut, someone 
clearly runs ahead. The Umamusume Narita 
Top Road aims for is—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Haaaah--!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Huff, puff... Still not enough. My speed 
on the final stretch...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Good work, Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh, Class Rep... Do you need something?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If you mean my homework notebook, I 
should've already turned it in.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not that, I just wanted to say a 
quick hello.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
My debut in the Twinkle Series has been 
set for this year too. Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: We're classmates, aren't we, Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This Umamusume is Admire Vega. She's in 
the same class as Narita Top Road, and 
carries an air of dark sorrow about her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Quiet though he may be, his late burst is 
dazzling. A true talent blessed with 
blistering, instantaneous speed.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: My classmate... huh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I see... Regardless of who my opponent is, 
all I must do is win.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —See ya.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, yes...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega walked away, leaving behind 
only curt words.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san... She didn't really pay much 
attention to us, did she?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No, I think it's only natural. It's not as 
though I'm a buzzworthy Umamusume or 
anything.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No matter what anyone thinks, I want to 
run with you, Ayabe-san. More than anyone 
else.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
There isn't another Umamusume around who 
can run as amazingly as she does! That's 
why!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"The summit we are aiming for— I'm certain 
it lies wherever Ayabe-san is heading."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if unrecognized by the one she 
admires, the light in Narita Top Road's 
eyes will never dim.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
